capabilities: Draw an interactive family tree from person note properties
Compute kinship routes and terms between two people
Import GEDCOM and «Древо Жизни» files with photos
Export the tree as SVG, PNG or tiled PDF for print
Add and edit people on the graph through a side form
disambiguation: Not a general graph view of the vault; it draws family trees only from notes with type: person.
extras: Docs are split across external guides (interface, data, import, export). README states the plugin works offline with no network requests and stores data as plain Markdown following GEDCOM conventions.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows plain note links, not family relationships, portraits, generations or kinship terms between people.
summary: Interactive family tree graph built from person notes' properties, with kinship routes, GEDCOM import and large-format print export.
